summary.text: Chris Flanagan is a Democratic member of the Massachusetts House of Representatives for the 1st Barnstable District, which includes Brewster, Dennis and parts of Yarmouth.

The Legislature's committee listing shows him on the House Committee on Climate Action and Sustainability and the Joint Committees on Advanced Information Technology, the Internet and Cybersecurity, Agriculture and Fisheries, and Emergency Preparedness and Management.
